sources: 40 review packets named by the pinned landed-outputs manifest, each verified against its manifest digest: sp_durable/Dan/primaries/rev_{LF,OL}_c01..c11.json; review/peer/peer_g01..g06.json; review/p13/p13_{OS,TB}.json; review/p13r7/p13r7_{OS,TB}.json; review/rr8, rr9, rr10/rrN_{OS,TB}.json; review/boss/dan_boss_audit.v1.json; review/boss/supp_e2/dan_boss_audit_b8_b14.json

changed.why: Atlas generator ported in form from the earlier book's tool. Builds the feed rows and the dimensions record from pinned inputs whose digests it verifies; takes --dan-root and --out-root; --check prints DETERMINISTIC: MATCH.

49 feed rows, one per final row graded low (2) or medium_low (47), in the 16 shared-feed fields. Each mirrors its row's span, confidence and review state, with candidate_hold_state null and review_packet_final_state accepted_candidate.

1 header, 75 unit records, 348 open-question records and 260 linkage records. Unit records keep measured, dependency and judged in separate blocks; the risk rating is left out and the record says so. Open questions carry a blast-radius class; linked pairs carry a statement on any difference in treatment.

Checker that imports nothing from the generator. 23 checks and 14 in-memory tampers. It re-derives the Hebrew-numbering spans by positional alignment, re-reads the blind lanes' verdicts, and re-opens every linkage source.
Check record: overall PASS, every tamper caught, generator check DETERMINISTIC: MATCH.
Sidecar generator. It imports the atlas generator, refuses if the atlas rows on disk differ from a rebuild, and prints MATCH as the last line of --check with exit 0.
49 sidecar rows keyed by writer_decision_id, exactly the low and medium_low rows. All six required fields are non-empty and every why_low_confidence is unique.
Derivation record: for each sidecar row, the source and tier of each field.
Daniel's own description of the files, the measured counts, the rules and the limits. Its key numbers were compared by script with the measured header.
What was ported, what changed for Daniel and why, the measured counts, and every limit.
All six units recorded complete, next_cursor null, accepted false (acceptance is not mine to give).

unresolved_uncertainty.what: The run with default roots after install was not executed; the last verification entry is marked refuted only because the schema has no not-run value.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: The orchestrator's re-run of each --check after install is the first real test of byte identity at the installed location.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: Six linked pairs are classed possible_inconsistency_unruled: W6-002/W6-003, W6-002/W6-005, W6-002/W6-006, W6-003/W6-005, W6-003/W6-006 (Dan.10.4 to Dan.11.6, from rev_OL_c10 unresolved[0]) and W6-014/W6-015 (Dan.12.5-Dan.12.13, from peer_g06 items[6]).
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: The rule matched a word of divergence and found no ruling naming both units. I judged no boundary, so these are candidates for the end review. Item 22 fails an unremarked divergence; they are remarked, but a reader must decide whether each is a real distinction.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: The shared feed atlas_candidate_feed.jsonl was not pinned and was not read. The 16 field names and the reviewer and action vocabulary (human_owner, convergence, literary_form_reviewer, consider_only) are constants taken from the earlier tool's form.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: If the live feed's schema or vocabulary has moved, the rows need adjusting before the owner merges them.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: Blast-radius classes, divergence statements and hardness are rule output over word matches (JUDGED_BY_RULE). Of the 348 questions, 235 are one_book and 60 campaign_wide; 4 routed items are one_unit (E4-C10-W1-002, E6-SEAM-W2-013-014, E9-PEER-W6-009, E9-PEER-W6-013).
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: The rule leans wide by design, so it may over-class. A convention question worded without any marker word and naming exactly one unit would still be misfiled as one_unit.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: The 302 unresolved entries from packets and rulings are recorded as raised; whether a later round settled each is not derived.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: Some are probably closed already, so the open-question count overstates what is still open. Only the 46 routed items are known to be carried open.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: Linkages are harvested by unit id only, and severity counts do not deduplicate a finding repeated by a later round.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: Cross-references written only as chapter and verse are missing from the linkage set, and severity totals (2 high, 21 medium, 110 low) may count one concern more than once.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: Transcribed sentences are split at full stops and semicolons, so some begin mid-clause, and a row-internal label such as a region letter can travel.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: The prose is faithful to the rows but not always polished, and the owner may want to read it before publication.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: The answerable-from-the-witnesses rating is left_out for 30 units, and no risk rating is derived for any unit.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: The brief requires an underivable rating to be left out and said to be left out; a later reviewer must supply these if they are wanted.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: The checker shares no code with the generator but was written by the same builder on the same model family (OW-19, grader_fallback OW-25).
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: It is one voice and not independent review.

e19_selfreport: ran no listing, no glob, no recursive search; read only the exact paths named in the brief or in the pinned landed-outputs manifest. One disclosure: gen_atlas_rows.py and gen_sidecars.py call is_file() on their own named output files, by exact path, inside --check and the overwrite guard (ported from the template's form). That is an existence test on the tool's own output and scans no directory; change it to a guarded read if E-19 is read to forbid it. No git, no receipt, no registry write, and no write outside OUT.
limit: accountable work summary; not chain of thought and not independent proof. Fresh execution e1, not a continuation after an interruption, though the context was compacted once mid-run and work resumed from work/progress.json and the summary.
